How discovery works

Favourite-based recommendations and genre discovery use Qloo. Actor filmographies and recorded original-language matches use Wikidata. OMDb supplies available posters, IMDb scores, and film details. Gemini interprets requests. Rankings cover the returned shortlist; coverage varies and dubbed streaming availability is not verified.
